A table t is a set of data elements arranged by vertical columns and horizontal rows. Formally, we deﬁne a table as a triple t = {headers, cells, caption} that con- sists of three aspects. answer: No. The paper's released dataset includes 273,816 web tables from Wikipedia [4][6], and to enlarge the search space they additionally extract 252,703 web tables from Wikipedia as searchable tables [5]. The passages do not establish that every table comes from a single website; they only identify Wikipedia as a source of many of the tables [5][6].
